issues.problem: The Chinese flags the source wording with a parenthetical original-text quote (原文「詳弃鼓旗」); the English renders the sense as 'made a show of abandoning their drums and standards' but drops the citation of the original phrase.
issues.suggestion: Optionally add the original phrase, e.g. 'made a show of abandoning their drums and standards (the text has 詳弃鼓旗).'

issues.problem: Where Chinese says only 败军之将、亡国之臣，不足以议大事 ('a defeated general and a minister of a ruined state, not fit to discuss great matters'), the English adds two distinct claims — 'cannot speak of courage' and 'a minister of a ruined state cannot plan survival' — and also calls him 'a captured and ruined man', none of which is in the Chinese line.
issues.suggestion: Trim to match the Chinese, e.g. 'a defeated general, a minister of a ruined state — not one to weigh great matters with.'

overall: The English edition tracks the Chinese faithfully on all facts, numbers, names, quotations and hedges; the only divergences are two minor source-gloss/expansion points flagged as notes, with no content mismatches.
